title: The two alphabets
prompt:
The letters are only a carrier. Their case is the message.
lower=0, UPPER=1. Read groups of five from the left. Use the full 26-letter alphabet, a=00000.
Do not collapse i/j or u/v. This text is a primer, not the final answer.
after-case.txt is Vigenere with a=0, encryption C=P+K mod 26. Its key begins with the primer, then continues with the plaintext itself.
The recovered lowercase plaintext is the answer. The two alphabets are typography and number.
